tldr: **台股飆漲2.88%收44,611.6點，外資買超903億寫史上第三大。**
**金融三業上半年獲利創高達9,042億元，年增139%。**
**新台幣升至32.315元，22檔海外股票ETF創新高、統一FANG+領軍。**

items.title_en: TAIEX surges 1,251 points to 44,611.6 as foreign funds post third-largest daily buy (2026-08-05)
items.summary_zh: 加權指數8月5日勁揚1,250.94點、漲幅2.88%，收在44,611.6點，成交量放大至1.14兆元重回兆元大關，並一舉站上月線與季線。中東緊張緩和、美元轉弱使熱錢回流亞洲，外資單日買超903.08億元、寫下史上第三大紀錄，權王台積電上漲85元收2,405元，帶動大盤攻堅。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark jumped 1,250.94 points, or 2.88%, to close at 44,611.60 on Aug 5, reclaiming the NT$1tn turnover mark (NT$1.14tn) and breaking above its monthly and quarterly moving averages. Foreign investors bought a net NT$90.3bn — the third-largest single-day total on record — as easing Middle East tension and a softer US dollar drew hot money back into Asia. TSMC rose NT$85 to NT$2,405.

items.title_en: NT dollar climbs to 32.315 as stocks and currency rally together (2026-08-05)
items.summary_zh: 8月5日新台幣兌美元一度強升逾1.7角、盤中攻抵32.274元，尾盤升幅收斂，終場升值1.32角收在32.315元。美伊可能達成重啟荷姆茲海峽協議帶動油價重挫、美元走弱，外資回頭大買台股903億元，推動股匯同步走揚。亞幣普遍走升，韓元升0.5%最強、新台幣升0.41%居次。
items.summary_en: The New Taiwan dollar strengthened 0.132 to close at 32.315 per US dollar on Aug 5, at one point gaining more than 0.17, as hopes of a US–Iran deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz sank oil and weakened the greenback. Foreign investors' NT$90.3bn equity buying reinforced the twin rally; regional peers also firmed, with the Korean won up 0.5% and the Taiwan dollar 0.41%.

items.title_zh: 環宇-KY：光通訊供不應求 訂單能見度看到年底（2026-08-05）
items.title_en: Universal Microwave sees optical-component demand outstripping supply into year-end (2026-08-05)
items.summary_zh: 環宇-KY（4991）8月5日法說指出，AI資料中心帶動光電晶圓代工與自有品牌AOC需求強勁，在手訂單能見度看到2026年底，全年出貨樂觀。公司表示，若美方禁止進口中國新型光收發器將是加分。第2季營收7.7億元、年增57.2%，稅後純益年增達672%；惟毛利率因產品組合降至43.3%，第3季預估回升至44%-48%。
items.summary_en: At its Aug 5 earnings call, Universal Microwave Technology (4991) said AI-data-centre demand for its optical foundry and active optical cables (AOC) is strong, with order visibility through end-2026. Management said a potential US ban on new Chinese-made optical transceivers would be an added tailwind. Q2 revenue rose 57.2% YoY to NT$770m and net profit jumped 672% YoY, though gross margin slipped to 43.3% on product mix.

items.title_zh: 鴻海7月營收9,465億創新高 逼近單月兆元（2026-08-05）
items.title_en: Hon Hai posts record July revenue of NT$946.5bn, nearing the monthly trillion mark (2026-08-05)
items.summary_zh: 鴻海（2317）公告7月營收9,465.12億元，創歷史單月新高，月增15.18%、年增54.19%，有望成為台股首家單月營收破兆的廠商。累計前7月營收5.59兆元同創同期新高、年增37.89%。強勁動能反映AI伺服器與雲端基礎建設需求熾熱，也帶動整體電子代工供應鏈成長。
items.summary_en: Foxconn (Hon Hai, 2317) reported July revenue of NT$946.51bn, an all-time monthly high, up 15.18% MoM and 54.19% YoY, positioning it to potentially become Taiwan's first company to book NT$1tn in monthly sales. Cumulative Jan–July revenue reached NT$5.59tn, also a record for the period and up 37.89% YoY, underscoring booming AI-server and cloud-infrastructure demand across the electronics supply chain.

items.title_zh: 金融三業上半年賺逾9,042億 年增139%創高（2026-08-05）
items.title_en: Taiwan's financial sector books record H1 profit of NT$904.2bn, up 139% (2026-08-05)
items.summary_zh: 2026年上半年銀行、保險、證期三大金融業合計獲利達9,042.45億元，年增139.14%，全年挑戰歷史新高。以獲利結構觀察，銀行約占44%、保險約34%、證券期貨投信投顧約21%。市場多頭、手續費收入強勁及保險業獲利回升共同推升表現，顯示金融業景氣位居高檔。
items.summary_en: Combined first-half 2026 profit across banking, insurance and securities/futures reached NT$904.245bn, a 139.14% jump from a year earlier and on track to challenge a full-year record. Banks contributed about 44% of earnings, insurers 34% and securities, futures and investment-trust firms around 21%, as buoyant markets, strong fee income and a recovering insurance sector lifted results.

items.title_zh: 有保險業務的11家金控 每月獲利可延至15日公布（2026）
items.title_en: FSC lets insurance-linked financial holdings report monthly earnings by the 15th (2026)
items.summary_zh: 金管會調整揭露規範，讓旗下有保險業務的11家金控每月獲利數字得延後至每月15日前公布，較原時程放寬。此舉在IFRS 17與新清償能力制度下，給予保險子公司更充裕時間完成公允價值評價與結算，以提升較複雜保險帳務的申報正確性，兼顧資訊揭露時效與品質。
items.summary_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission has adjusted disclosure rules so that the 11 financial holding companies with insurance operations may publish monthly profit figures by the 15th of each month, easing the earlier deadline. The change gives insurers more time to finalise results under IFRS 17 and the new solvency regime, improving reporting accuracy for the sector's more complex, fair-value-based accounts.
items.source_name: 經濟日報 金融脈動

items.title_zh: 22檔海外股票ETF同創新高 統一FANG+近一周飆12%最猛（2026-08-05）
items.title_en: 22 overseas-equity ETFs hit record highs; Uni-President FANG+ leads with a 12% surge (2026-08-05)
items.summary_zh: 美股科技與半導體自7月30日低點強彈，帶動22檔在台掛牌海外股票ETF於8月5日改寫新高。統一FANG+（00757）以近一周漲12.35%居冠、收141.95元再創高，其後為國泰網路資安（00875）、大華美國MAG7+（009815）。經理人認為資本支出逐步轉化為雲端營收構成續強底氣，惟殖利率高檔與油價震盪仍是變數，建議長線定期定額布局。
items.summary_en: A rebound in US mega-cap tech and semiconductors since the July 30 low drove 22 Taiwan-listed foreign-equity ETFs to fresh highs on Aug 5. Uni-President FANG+ ETF (00757) topped the list, rallying 12.35% to a record NT$141.95, followed by Cathay Cybersecurity (00875) and Da Hua US MAG7+ (009815). Managers see AI capex converting into cloud revenue as the key support, while flagging high yields and choppy oil as risks and favouring dollar-cost averaging.

items.title_zh: 十億超高資產家族 境外配置幾成標配
items.title_en: Offshore allocation becomes near-standard for Taiwan's billion-dollar UHNW families
items.summary_zh: 針對台灣超高資產客群的產業研究指出，未來成長動能強勁：整體高資產客群資產至2029年年複合成長率約10%，其中十億等級（逾10億元）超高資產族群最快、約11%。境外資產配置在頂層幾乎成為標配，約86%的十億級家族持有海外資產、逾半數海外配置達兩成以上，促使銀行加大跨境財管與家族辦公室布局的競爭力道。
items.summary_en: Industry research on Taiwan's ultra-high-net-worth clients points to double-digit growth ahead, with the overall UHNW segment's assets projected to compound at about 10% a year through 2029 and the NT$1bn-plus tier fastest at roughly 11%. Offshore allocation is now near-universal at the top: about 86% of billion-tier families hold overseas assets and more than half keep at least 20% of wealth abroad, intensifying banks' cross-border and family-office competition.
